displayDescription.en:
BenchCouncil lists ChatGPT in the LLM area of its AI100 (2022-2023) annual table. It associates the work with the publication “ChatGPT: Optimizing Language Models for Dialogue”. The page leaves the Main Contributors field blank, so this record does not infer individual names.

This Archive record preserves the official row order, citation value, institution, and country fields. It represents the annual 2022-2023 selection and remains separate from the long-term canonical AI100 storyline.
displayDescription.zh:
BenchCouncil 在 AI100（2022-2023）年度表的“大语言模型”领域列出 ChatGPT。该条目关联论文《ChatGPT: Optimizing Language Models for Dialogue》。页面的“主要人物”字段为空，因此本记录不自行补充个人姓名。

本 Archive 记录保留官方行序、引用数、机构和国家字段。它表示 2022-2023 年度入选记录，与长期 canonical AI100 故事线分开维护。
